justification: Changes what public pages show for council DCP rules: unproven wording becomes a page pointer. Not Critical: one shared helper, no DB write, reversible by revert. Not Minor: changes served regulatory content on 1,137 rows.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: An unconfirmed or never-checked DCP chapter rule's extracted text (e.g. 'Maximum height 9m') reaches shownText output, or an LEP row with a council name and no chapter is withheld.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: quote_status is written by scripts/council_quote.py from the council PDF; migration 112 triggers null it when the council file changes.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the change the old test expected shownText of an unconfirmed rule to be 'Maximum height 9m'; the new test fails against the old helper because that text is returned instead of the pointer.

pre_impl.existing_data: 57,541 live actionable council rows: 1,137 unconfirmed or never-checked with a chapter (penrith 368, ashfield 160, parramatta 129). 495 inner_west rows carry a council name but no chapter (LEP clauses).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: First version withheld by source_council alone and would have hidden all 495 inner_west LEP clauses (council_quote never checks rows without a chapter).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new file. One helper (lib/council-quote.ts) used by five routes.

functions.name: isWithheld
functions.what: True for a council DCP rule whose words are not proven in the council's current plan.
functions.input: one served rule row with source_council, source_chapter_key, quote_status, council_quote, quote_page, provision_text
functions.output: true when the rule's extracted words must not be shown to the user
functions.if_none: No source_council -> false (LEP/SEPP untouched). No chapter and no verdict -> false (outside the check).
functions.edge_cases: Hollow exact (status but no stored words) -> withheld. not_a_control -> shown.
functions.failure_mode: A route not selecting source_chapter_key leaves never-checked rows shown with the note (fails open on that one case); unconfirmed is withheld regardless.

functions.name: shownText
functions.what: The text a rule shows: council words, a page pointer when withheld, else extracted text.
functions.input: one served rule row with source_council, source_chapter_key, quote_status, council_quote, quote_page, provision_text
functions.output: the council's words, or a pointer to the page in the council's plan, or our extracted text for rows outside the check
functions.if_none: provision_text null stays null unless withheld.
functions.edge_cases: Idempotent when the client re-applies it to a served row.
functions.failure_mode: None silent: a withheld rule always shows the pointer text.

break_it.scenario: An LEP clause carries a council name but no DCP chapter (495 inner_west rows).
break_it.what_happens: Would be hidden though the wording check never covers it.
break_it.how: Withhold needs unconfirmed, or no verdict AND a chapter key.

break_it.scenario: Council replaces its PDF; trigger nulls the quotes.
break_it.what_happens: Superseded wording would keep showing as 'our reading'.
break_it.how: No verdict + chapter key -> pointer, until council_quote re-proves.
break_it.repro: council-quote.test.ts withheld case with quote_status null

break_it.scenario: A rule is marked exact but its stored quote is blank.
break_it.what_happens: Our extracted text would be shown as if proven.
break_it.how: hasCouncilWords requires the words and their page; otherwise withheld.
break_it.repro: council-quote.test.ts 'never serves a confirmed status without stored words'

verified: tsc: no errors in changed files
prod read-only: 1,137 of 57,541 live council rows withheld
jest 26 suites / 318 tests on changed areas
dry run --unchecked: 74 city_of_sydney rules, 56 exact / 2 recovered / 16 unconfirmed (no write)
gaps: canibuildit/check serves council setback wording from dcp_setback_controls (another table, own check) -- separate decision.
dcp/full-text: a canonical row with no current live row is served as before (no council name to judge).
